Draft a professional booking confirmation email to Priya Sharma (priya.sharma@example.com) presenting the suggested time slots. The email should:

1. Open with a warm, personalised greeting.
2. Briefly confirm the meeting type and purpose.
3. Present the 2–3 time slot options clearly.
4. Ask them to reply with their preferred slot.
5. Include a friendly closing and the host's signature line (use placeholder: [Host Name], [Title]).

Keep it under 150 words. Professional but human.
